results.title: Cyber: destructive logical corruption
results.description: The orders table is destroyed on the primary, and replication faithfully copies the damage to site B. Recovery requires containment, choosing a clean restore point, and restoring from the backup vault.

runbook.name: Fault: orders table destroyed on primary (replicates to DR)
Identify last clean restore point in vault

results.title: DR: loss of primary site
results.description: All of site A (both app nodes and the primary database) is lost at once. Site B's replica is promoted and its warm standby app takes traffic.

runbook.name: Fault: site A lost (app-a1, app-a2, pg-a)
Validate site B serving via LB

results.title: HA: application node failure
results.description: One of two site A application nodes is killed. The load balancer should route around it with no human action.

runbook.name: LB health check removes node (no human action)

results.title: HA: primary database failure
results.description: The primary database is killed. The standby is promoted after an incident declaration; apps reconnect via a multi-host connection string.
